ASUS today announced that the ASUS Googlebook 14 (CX9406CAA) is now available for purchase in the United States. The 14-inch ultraportable laptop is the first-ever ASUS laptop designed for Gemini Intelligence, combining effortless portability, strong performance, and premium craftsmanship for users seeking a more connected experience with their Android phone.

With every purchase of ASUS Googlebook 14, users receive up to $500 in additional value through a curated bundle of popular apps and services, most notably 12 months of Google AI Pro, unlocking expanded access to advanced features across Gemini, Flow, and Gemini Notebook, as well as Gemini integrated directly into the Google apps they use every day. Users also get 5TB of cloud storage to securely back up photos, files, and more, with access from virtually anywhere.1

In addition, the offer includes three months of YouTube Premium, Adobe Premiere Pro, Adobe Photoshop, and CapCut Pro, along with 12 months of Luminar and GeForce NOW. Together, these tools support creativity, entertainment, and cloud gaming right out of the box.2

Weighing just 2.18lbs and measuring only 0.43 inches thin, ASUS Googlebook 14 is engineered for exceptional mobility without compromising durability. Its CNC-machined magnesium-aluminum alloy chassis delivers impressive rigidity and long-term structural stability in a highly portable form factor. Finished in Dusk Ash and protected by Nano Ceramic Technology, the laptop is designed to resist scratches, stains, and everyday wear while maintaining a premium look and feel. The device is also tested to meet US military-grade MIL-STD 810H and ASUS Superior Durability standards.3

Despite its lightweight design, ASUS Googlebook 14 delivers strong performance with an Intel® Core™ Ultra 5 325 processor, 16GB LPDDR5X memory, and up to a 512GB PCIe® 4.0 SSD. An advanced cooling system helps sustain performance while keeping operation whisper-quiet, and a 70Wh battery provides up to 18 hours of battery life.4

For immersive visuals, the laptop features a 14-inch 16:10 3K OLED HDR touchscreen with up to 1000 nits peak HDR brightness and a 120Hz refresh rate. Corning® Gorilla™ Glass Victus® with Corning® Gorilla™ Matte anti-glare technology helps reduce reflections while improving durability and outdoor visibility. A six-speaker audio system, large haptic touchpad, and backlit keyboard with 1.5mm key travel enhance everyday interactions across work and entertainment.
To round out the experience, ASUS Googlebook 14 includes dual Thunderbolt™ 4 USB-C® ports, dual USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-A ports, HDMI® 2.1b, a 3.5mm audio combo jack, and WiFi 7 for seamless connectivity.

Built on a shared Android foundation, ASUS Googlebook 14 delivers a connected experience that helps users move effortlessly between their phone and laptop.5 During setup, users can securely bring over saved passwords, Wi-Fi® networks, settings, and messages with end-to-end encryption.
